notes: ACCESS: birchlane.com (Wayfair-family brand) answered plain curl_cffi browser impersonation this session (HTTP 200), with 429s from some profiles (notably chrome131/chrome124) that cleared by rotating to safari15_5/firefox133/edge101/safari18_0/safari17_2_ios with ~3s pacing between requests; no proxy needed. robots.txt was fetched FIRST: single 'User-agent: *' group, no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot group and no 'Disallow: /' anywhere -> not blocked. robots.txt explicitly Allows '/*/sb0/', '/*/sb1/', '/*/sb2/' (leaf listing paths) while Disallowing the general '/*/sb*/' pattern, and says nothing about '/*/cat/' hub paths (allowed by omission) -- same platform pattern as Wayfair (b1.json). TREE: built top-down from Birch Lane's own React/RSC category-navigation payload (BlockBuilderCategoryStandardCategoryNavigation / TopBlocks-CategoryNavigation block), read out of the server-rendered HTML of the top hub https://www.birchlane.com/bathroom/cat/bathroom-c1867193.html and its 3 sub-hubs: Bath Linens & Accessories (c1860612, 6 children), Bathroom Vanities & Mirrors (c1864509, 4 children), Bathroom Fixtures & Hardware (c1869346, 10 children, one of which -- Shower Heads, Faucets & Systems c1870971 -- is itself a listing page with categoryGroups:[] i.e. no further children, so its own /cat/ URL was recorded as a leaf). The homepage mega-menu independently surfaced the identical 20-link set, confirming the tree is exhaustive; a Storage-department cross-link page (storage/cat/bathroom-laundry-storage-solutions-c1875437, 440 Items, breadcrumb rooted in Storage not Bathroom) was also opened and found to only re-surface categories already captured (bathroom-vanities, medicine-cabinets, bathroom-cabinets-shelves, laundry-baskets) plus pure Storage/Kitchen ids (1875467/1875469/1875470 under /storage/sb0/, 1870091 under /kitchen-tabletop/) -- contributed zero new Bathroom leaves and was not itself recorded (parent/cross-department node, rule 24). QTY: every count is the page's own 'N Items' string, present twice per page (once inside the React RSC JSON payload as BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount children, once as the literally rendered header text over the grid) -- both matched character-for-character for all 20 pages fetched. EXCLUDED/ROUTED: Bath Towels (97 Items), Bathrobes (7), Shower Curtains (22), Bath Rugs & Mats (13) -> TEXTILE per rule 20/16 (site names them plainly, product titles on Bath Rugs & Mats are all 'Cotton Bath Rug/Mat'); Laundry Baskets (17) -> STORAGE per rule 12/30-33 (product titles are hampers/wire baskets/canvas bins, general laundry storage, not bathroom-fixture hardware); Vanity Lighting (291) -> LIGHTING per rule 11 (primary type = lighting; its home URL is /lighting/sb0/, not /bathroom/); Cabinet Knobs & Pulls (77) and Floor & Wall Tile (74) were cross-listed inside the Bathroom Fixtures & Hardware group but their actual site-hierarchy home is /kitchen-tabletop/ (cat and sb0 respectively) -- general cabinet hardware and building-material tile, not bathroom-specific fixtures, so excluded per PRIMARY PRODUCT TYPE + WEBSITE HIERARCHY rule and not recorded as Bathroom rows. CROSS-CATEGORY DEDUP (checked programmatically against cross_category_url_index.json for every one of the above candidate URLs plus all 8 kept rows): Bathroom Vanities (315) already in Furniture.xlsx; Medicine Cabinets (15) already in Storage.xlsx; Bathroom Cabinets & Shelves (13) already in both Furniture.xlsx and Storage.xlsx; Vanity Mirrors (51) already in Wall_Decor.xlsx; Bath Towels/Bathrobes/Shower Curtains/Bath Rugs & Mats already in Textile.xlsx; Laundry Baskets already in Storage.xlsx; Vanity Lighting already in Lighting.xlsx -- all of these were therefore NOT written to rows[] and instead placed in review[] with 'ALREADY EXTRACTED IN <file>'. Cabinet Knobs & Pulls and Floor & Wall Tile returned no dedup hit but are excluded anyway as non-bathroom-owned per hierarchy (documented in review[] as routed out, not as dedup). REMAINING 8 genuine, unclaimed Bathroom leaves were written to rows[]: Bathroom Sink Faucets, Bathroom Sinks, Tub Faucets, Tubs & Whirlpools, Shower Heads Faucets & Systems, Towel Bars & Racks, Bathroom Hardware Sets, Bath Accessories (the last verified by inspecting product card aria-labels: Rechargeable Sensor Soap Dispenser, Glass Soap Dispenser, Bathroom Storage Container -- genuine bathroom accessories per rule 13, not textile/decor). No View All/Shop All/search/promotional URLs were recorded. No group/parent-only rows were needed since every hub had extractable leaf children.
